title: Adversarial Nibbler: A Data-Centric Challenge for Improving the Safety of Text-to-Image Models
benchmark_measurement: Stereotype and bias detection related to religious identity groups in text-to-image generation. The challenge measures participants' ability to find 'benign prompts' that trigger the models to generate harmful or biased images, specifically including negative stereotypes targeting religious groups.
findings: This paper proposes a challenge rather than presenting results. Its key premise related to religion is that text-to-image models are vulnerable to generating harmful, stereotypical images of religious groups from seemingly innocuous prompts. For example, the paper notes that a prompt like 'a Muslim man holding an object' can trigger a model to generate an image of a man holding a gun, which constitutes a 'negative stereotype targeting Muslims'.
